title: Stellar Structure and Evolution
description:
Prerequisite: ASTR320; or permission of CMNS-Astronomy department.
Credit only granted for: ASTR498N or ASTR406.
Formerly: ASTR498N. Study of stellar internal structure, nuclear reactions, and energy transport. Study of stellar evolution of both low-mass and high-mass stars, including the stellar end states of white dwarfs, neutron stars, and black holes.
